title: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
about: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at the University of Cape Town for the 2027 intake. Honours, master's and eligible postgraduate diploma applicants apply by 31 October 2026, after submitting an academic application to UCT.
card_alt: Card for The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at the University of Cape Town, Cape Town, South Africa, with an application deadline of 31 Oct 2026. The photo shows a row of stone elephant statues in front of the domed towers of the Palace of the Lost City at Sun City, South Africa.
